# TogetherList

> Free real-time collaborative list app — no sign-up, no download, no account needed.

## About

TogetherList is a free web application for creating and sharing real-time collaborative lists. No sign-up, login, or app download is required. Create a list, share the link, and collaborate instantly.

- Homepage: https://togetherlist.eu
- Full documentation for LLMs: https://togetherlist.eu/llms-full.txt

## Features

- Instant list creation and sharing via unique URL
- Real-time synchronization across all participants
- No sign-up, login, or authentication required
- Assign items to specific participants by name
- Mobile-friendly responsive web design
- 100% free with no hidden costs
